In [[mathematical analysis]], the '''Agranovich–Dynin formula''' is a [[formula]] for the index of an [[Elliptic partial differential equation|elliptic]] system of [[differential operator]]s, introduced by 
{{harvs|txt|last1=Agranovich|author1-link=Mikhail Semenovich Agranovich|last2=Dynin|author2-link=Alexander Dynin|year=1962}}.
